extension.description: Read, search and triage your mail in the editor. Talks to a local mailcoded daemon over stdio and never connects to a mail server itself.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Mail can be read, searched and organised in a restricted workspace. Composing, replying, sending and adding an account are disabled, and the daemon path and data directory can only come from user or machine settings.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: The mail store is a local database, so mail is only available when the extension host runs on the machine that holds it.

welcome.noAccounts:
Connected to the mailcoded daemon, but it has no mail accounts.
Adding an account from the editor is not built yet. Run `mailcoded setup` in a terminal, then refresh.
[Refresh](command:mailcoded.refresh)
[Restart daemon](command:mailcoded.restartDaemon)
welcome.daemonMissing:
The mailcoded daemon could not be started.
[Set daemon path](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22mailcoded.daemonPath%22%5D)
[Show log](command:mailcoded.showDaemonLog)
Install the daemon from the mailcoded engine, or point the setting at the binary you already have.
welcome.protocolMismatch:
The daemon speaks a JSON-RPC protocol version this extension does not understand.
Update whichever of the two is older, then reload. Mailcoded: Show Daemon Info reports both versions.
welcome.failed:
The mailcoded daemon stopped unexpectedly.
[Restart daemon](command:mailcoded.restartDaemon)
[Show log](command:mailcoded.showDaemonLog)

config.daemonPath.description: Absolute path to the mailcoded daemon executable. Leave empty to look for `mailcoded` on the PATH.
config.dataDir.description: Directory holding the mail store. Leave empty for the platform default. Never point this inside a workspace folder.
config.pageSize.description: Number of messages requested per page in the message list.
config.markReadOnOpen.description: Mark a message as read when it is opened in the reader.
config.logLevel.description: Verbosity of the Mailcoded Daemon output channel.
config.logLevel.info: Sync results, daemon lifecycle and errors.
config.logLevel.debug: Every JSON-RPC call. Verbose; message bodies and secrets are still never logged.
config.quoteLines.description: Maximum number of lines of the original message quoted into a reply.
config.threadGrouping.description: Group the message list into conversation threads.
config.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the daemon polls a folder for new mail when the server does not support IMAP IDLE.
